deadlock.name: deadlock
deadlock.title: Deadlock
deadlock.description: All coils forced to 0: no step is active.

coil_manipulation.name: coil_manipulation
coil_manipulation.title: Coil manipulation
coil_manipulation.description: A random subset of coils receives random binary values at every scan.

spurious_activation.name: spurious_activation
spurious_activation.title: Spurious activation
spurious_activation.description: An inactive step is forced active.

step_suppression.name: step_suppression
step_suppression.title: Step suppression
step_suppression.description: An active step is forced inactive (lost token).

illegal_jump.name: illegal_jump
illegal_jump.title: Illegal jump
illegal_jump.description: The token of an active step is moved to a step that is not one of its successors.

or_violation.name: or_violation
or_violation.title: OR exclusivity violation
or_violation.description: When an OR divergence fires, a second alternative is activated as well.

partial_and.name: partial_and
partial_and.title: Partial AND divergence
partial_and.description: When an AND divergence fires, one of its branches is not activated.

premature_join.name: premature_join
premature_join.title: Premature AND convergence
premature_join.description: A convergence step is activated before all its predecessor branches finished.

delay.name: delay
delay.title: Delay (freeze)
delay.description: The observed configuration is frozen, then the execution continues late.

wrong_branch.name: wrong_branch
wrong_branch.title: Wrong OR branch
wrong_branch.description: At an OR divergence the observation follows the other, legal alternative.

replay.name: replay
replay.title: Replay
replay.description: A recorded legal segment starting from the same configuration is replayed.
